_comment: Phase 34.9 Plan 06. Plan 34.9-09 replaces every PENDING-CI-PUBLISH sentinel below with the real sha256 digest published by .github/workflows/build-runners-onedir-macos.yml's SHA256SUMS-{arch} output. Changing ANY digest value here, or the layout string, intentionally forces every checkout to re-download the darwin runners -- see darwinLayoutMarker()/computeLayoutMarker() in meta/downloadHelperBinaries.ts. Phase 34.16 Plan 04 (D-10/D-11): runId is written by `pnpm pin:runner-digests` and names the workflow run whose SHA256SUMS-{arch} the digests below were taken from -- it is deliberately invisible to computeLayoutMarker(), which receives layout and digests positionally and therefore cannot see any sibling key.
